title: Choose the visual world for Noise Trap
question: The roll assigned the Survey Quadrangle sheet. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Survey Quadrangle
options.thesis: Every finding printed as a surveyed map sheet: the collar states what was measured, where, and how sure.
options.viewport: A world sheet fills the screen: honest-test cells in survey blue, usual-method cells in revision orange, the collar giving sheet title, years, grid, and the two percentages.
options.risk: Can read as an old atlas if the collar type is timid or the map is not the hero.

raised.raise: State is a mark, not only a hue: honest = solid survey dot, usual-only = hollow revision ring, so it survives colour-blindness and print.
Callouts pin to their cell with leader lines, like spot heights, never floating cards.
Places you investigate stay on the sheet as revision marks, a visible history.
Each variable owns one ink for its whole section, held with total commitment.

options.label: Earth Observatory Plate
options.thesis: The finding as a night-side satellite plate with a caption that tells you whether to believe it.
options.viewport: A dark full-bleed globe with trend cells glowing, a caption block lower left with the two percentages.
options.risk: Familiar: dark space dashboards are where most runs in this category land.

options.label: Napkin Zine
options.thesis: A friend sketches why sticky noise fools the usual test, panel by panel.
options.viewport: Panel 1: a marker headline 'Is this trend real?', a doodled wiggly line with an arrow from a mascot.
options.case: Wins on audience identification for the public; loses on clarity and credibility for validity judges.
options.risk: Playful tone undercuts the science claim.

options.label: Cutting Bench Rail
options.thesis: Sections strung along a perforated rail.
options.viewport: Orange rail across black with frames.
options.risk: Judges do not identify with film editing.
options.case: Loses both axes: the rail metaphor hides the map.
options.kept: State is a mark, not a hue.

options.label: Tensegrity Column
options.viewport: A strut network with pinned labels.
options.risk: Abstract; no link to Earth data.
options.kept: Annotations pinned to nodes on leader lines.

options.label: Flash Scrawl Sleeve
options.thesis: A defaced surface where marks pile up.
options.kept: Used marks stay on the surface as history.

options.label: Magazine Program
options.kept: One spot colour committed per section.

options.label: Curved Crease Shell
options.kept: Registered views: plan and section shown together.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A climate data dashboard: sidebar, KPI tiles, map and charts.
canonCard.viewport: Left nav, four stat tiles, a choropleth and a line chart.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other climate dashboard by design.
